name: RAINJOKE
source:
A Mortifying Love Story between a Knight and a Maid.

You are "Rainbow", you want to maintain your good standing. You are "Joke", you are going to mess it up for her.

骑士与女仆之间令人痛心的爱情故事。

你是“彩虹”，你想保持自己良好的信誉。你就是个“笑话”，你会把她的事情搞砸的。

[来自[url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/rainjoke]itch.io[/url]]
